interface.name: sparrow_ipc_manager_v1

description.summary: manager for secure private IPC channels

interface.description: This global interface allows authorized clients to obtain an anonymous, kernel-isolated socketpair file descriptor for bidirectional IPC with the Sparrow compositor.

request.name: get_ipc_channel

description.summary: request an anonymous secure IPC socket

request.description: Requests the compositor to create a private socketpair and send the client-side file descriptor back via the ipc_channel event.

event.name: ipc_channel

description.summary: delivers the private socketpair file descriptor

event.description: Transfers the private file descriptor of the socketpair to the client.
